mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_business_process_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{versionId} AND status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: FROM ai_business_process p INNER JOIN ai_business_process_version v ON v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND v.process_id = p.id AND v.version_no = p.published_version AND v.status = 1 AND v.del_flag = 0
